title: metais.validate/1
description: What metais validate prints with --json: every finding about the inputs supplied, and for every declared input whether it was supplied and where its value came from; with --resolved, the inputs as templates would see them (ADR-008 D7). A refused package or command line gives a null result.

inputs.description: One entry per declared input, in manifest order.

data.description: Present with --resolved: an object holding each input that has a value, after coercion and defaults, absent members absent, in canonical key order (ADR-002 D9).

supplied.description: Whether the data directory or a supply flag gave the input any of its value; false for an input absent or given only by a default.

from.description: Every source the value came from, in the order each was applied: empty for an absent input.

source.description: data_dir for a file or collection directory of the data directory, inputs_json, set and set_json for those flags, default for a schema default.

file.description: For data_dir: the path relative to the data directory, /-separated.

argument.description: For inputs_json, the flag's 1-based ordinal among the --inputs-json flags; for set and set_json, among the --set and --set-json flags together, as a finding's location numbers it.
